# Clarifai

Use `clarifai/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "clarifai-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "clarifai/arcee_ai/AFM/models/trinity-mini",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `CLARIFAI_PAT`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://api.clarifai.com/v2/ext/openai/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `CLARIFAI_BASE_URL`.

## Provider docs

- https://docs.clarifai.com/compute/inference/
